rules.statement: An executor de son tort is considered a legal representative of the deceased for the purposes of section 341.
rules.supporting_quote: (1) (Tennekoon C. J. dissenting) that an executor de son tort is a legal representative of the deceased within the meaning of section 341 (1) of the Civil Procedure Code. (2) An order for alimony pendente lite in favour of the wife necessarily comes to an end upon the death of the husband. A PPEAL from an Order of the District Court, Jaffna. C. Thiagalingam with C. Chellappah and S. Ruthiramoorthy for Appellant. C. Ranganathan with M. Sivarajasingham for Respondent

rules.statement: An order for alimony pendente lite terminates upon the death of the husband.
rules.supporting_quote: (1) (Tennekoon C. J. dissenting) that an executor de son tort is a legal representative of the deceased within the meaning of section 341 (1) of the Civil Procedure Code. (2) An order for alimony pendente lite in favour of the wife necessarily comes to an end upon the death of the husband. A PPEAL from an Order of the District Court, Jaffna. C. Thiagalingam with C.
